Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Resident Evil Combat, one complete static left-facing creature sprite study.
Image 1 is the authoritative documentary appearance reference for Thanatos-R, Resident Evil Outbreak (2003), including its exact mutated phase, anatomy, materials and asymmetry. Image 2 is a community port of the same Outbreak model, used ONLY to clarify the previously hidden lower leg and bare foot. Do not copy Image 2's blue scene lighting, environment, pose or altered presentation.
Create one independent LEFT-facing side/three-quarter full-body pose, not a mirror. Preserve the source-specific anatomy: the anatomical RIGHT arm is missing with a short shoulder stump; the anatomical LEFT arm is enormously enlarged and ends in the very long clawed hand shown. Exactly one complete arm plus the right stump, no regenerated right hand. The camera sees the anatomical LEFT side as nearer, so the huge left arm is the near arm and the right stump is farther away. Preserve the source's chest structure and damaged right shoulder region on their actual sides. The left leg is the more irregular, textured/armoured leg; the right leg is smoother. Keep both original legs and both bare feet, using Image 2 only to establish the lower left leg/foot that Image 1's claw hides. No boots or invented feet.
Head, torso, pelvis and both feet must all turn clearly LEFT in a static combat idle. Pose the giant claw so both foot tips can be inspected without overlap, while preserving the original hand proportions and complete claw tips. Keep the same black brief-like garment and grey-brown materials from Image 1. Do not substitute regular Thanatos, a beta model, another Tyrant, the 2019 remake style, or a two-armed form.
One whole subject, every anatomical endpoint contained with generous transparent margins around the stump, head, claw and toes. Genuinely transparent alpha, opaque body and clean anti-aliased contours. No floor, cast/contact shadow, smoke, matte halo, scene, extra character, lettering, labels or checkerboard. Match the source game model's detail level and materials without redesigning or adding fresh effects. This is a generated adaptation, not native Capcom pixels or a 1:1 certificate.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Resident Evil Combat, corrected Giant Wasp Outbreak (2003) left-facing sprite.
Image 1 is the original documentary identity/anatomy/edition reference. Image 2 is the generated left-facing candidate to correct. Change ONLY leg presentation and any necessary very small leg posing adjustment: Image 2 does not make six independent legs unambiguously traceable.
Show EXACTLY SIX legs total, three attached to the near side of the thorax and three attached to its far side, each a single coherent articulated limb from thorax to one distinct terminal tip. No seventh leg, no forked extra tibia, no tiny isolated hook counted as a leg, and no legs attached to the head or abdomen. Slightly stagger the near and far legs so all six chains and all six ends can be visually counted; avoid overlapping two legs into one stem. Retain the source's thin segmented insect legs, not human arms or claw hands.
Keep the current LEFT-facing head, body, abdomen, stinger, coloring and overall airborne pose. Preserve exactly the two large visible wing surfaces, their vein patterns and the distinctive tears/notches of the Outbreak variant. Keep the entire stinger and both wing tips in frame; do not add wings, antennae or other body appendages. Do not change the edition or horizontally mirror the image.
One complete subject on genuinely transparent background. Opaque body, clean antialiased contours, no floor, shadow, haze, RGB matte patch, scenery, text, UI or duplicate. Keep generous transparent margins. This correction is a generated study, not a certified original game asset.
